traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Celastrales page (read 2026-10-16): Celastraceae simple; Lepidobotrys simple with an articulated (unifoliolate) blade.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Celastrales page (read 2026-10-16): shrubs, trees, lianes, rarely herbs; Parnassia herbs with basal leaves (my knowledge).

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Celastrales page (read 2026-10-16): woody, the few herbs (Parnassia) perennial.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Celastrales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence cymose.

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Celastraceae (read 2026-10-16): cymes or fascicles terminal or axillary; axillary most common (my weighting, e.g. Euonymus, Maytenus).

traits.corolla_shape.note: DELTA Celastraceae (read 2026-10-16): free spreading petals around a disc; Celastraceae states rotate.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Celastrales page (read 2026-10-16): hypanthium not general, present in Stackhousioideae.

traits.ovary_position.note: DELTA Celastraceae (read 2026-10-16): superior, rarely partly inferior; APweb: ovary often sunk in the disc.

traits.fruit_type.note: DELTA Celastraceae (read 2026-10-16): capsule, berry, drupe, samara or achene-like; APweb: capsules often loculicidal or septicidal, seeds arillate. Capsule first is my weighting.

traits.sexual_system.note: DELTA Celastraceae (read 2026-10-16): usually hermaphrodite, some monoecious or dioecious; APweb order: functionally imperfect flowers common.
